visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a bustling outdoor shopfront at night, featuring a red sign with white text. A man in a blue t-shirt stands behind a stainless steel counter, while a white scooter is parked nearby under bright artificial lighting. (2) A medium shot shows the man in the blue shirt smiling as he uses a large wooden rolling pin to flatten dough on a white surface. Another man in a black shirt stands in the background near a large black cooking dome. (3) The man skillfully tosses the flattened dough onto a hot, black hemispherical pan to bake. The background shows the interior of the shop through glass windows. (4) A close-up focus on hands tearing a piece of light-brown, freshly baked tortilla, revealing its flexible texture. (5) In a different part of the kitchen, a woman wearing a black face mask and plastic gloves uses a metal spatula to stir-fry seasoned meat on a flat griddle. A man in glasses works behind her. (6) The camera captures a close-up of the seasoned meat and vegetables being tossed on the hot griddle with steam rising. (7) Two large, wrapped burritos are held up by hands against the backdrop of the shop interior, showcasing the parchment paper packaging. (8) A series of close-ups show a burrito being torn open to reveal layers of curry-colored meat, golden corn kernels, and shredded green cabbage. (9) A different burrito is presented, emphasizing a high density of fresh green cabbage and corn, held by a hand. (10) A hand holds up a plastic cup filled with light brown milk tea against the outdoor street background. (11) The video transitions to show the shop's interior menu board on a wall, with the masked woman working in the foreground. (12) The final shot shows the shop exterior featuring a blue and white striped awning and a red banner with white and yellow text.
